name: Descendant
defines: The point opposite the Ascendant: what you look for in other people, the qualities you meet in close partnership, and the part of yourself you tend to find through someone else.

aries.definition: You are drawn to decisiveness. Partnership brings you people who act, and through them you learn to want things directly yourself.
aries.showsUp: You end up with the bold ones, you are attracted to certainty, and your relationships have some healthy friction in them.

taurus.definition: You are drawn to steadiness. Partnership brings you people who are solid and unhurried, and through them you learn to stay put.
taurus.showsUp: You look for reliability over excitement, you value a partner who is calm, and you settle down more than you expected to.

gemini.definition: You are drawn to quickness of mind. Partnership brings you people who talk, and through them you learn to think out loud.
gemini.showsUp: You need conversation more than romance, you are attracted to wit, and you get restless with a partner who has nothing to say.

cancer.definition: You are drawn to care. Partnership brings you people who look after you, and through them you learn to admit that you need looking after.
cancer.showsUp: You look for warmth and safety in a partner, you are drawn to people who make a home, and closeness matters to you more than you let on.

leo.definition: You are drawn to warmth and confidence. Partnership brings you people with presence, and through them you learn to be seen.
leo.showsUp: You are attracted to generosity and a bit of flair, and you find your own confidence reflected back through the people you love.

virgo.definition: You are drawn to competence. Partnership brings you people who are careful and useful, and through them you learn to attend to detail.
virgo.showsUp: You value a partner who is genuinely good at things, you appreciate practical care over declarations, and you can be exacting about who qualifies.

libra.definition: You are drawn to grace and fairness. Partnership brings you people who meet you halfway, and through them you learn how to share the ground.
libra.showsUp: You want a genuine equal, you dislike relationships with an imbalance of power, and you take partnership seriously as a project.

scorpio.definition: You are drawn to depth. Partnership brings you people who are intense and private, and through them you learn how far down you are willing to go.
scorpio.showsUp: You have little patience for shallow connection, your relationships change you, and you are attracted to what you cannot immediately read.

sagittarius.definition: You are drawn to openness. Partnership brings you people who widen your world, and through them you learn to loosen your grip.
sagittarius.showsUp: You are attracted to honesty and a big outlook, you need room inside a relationship, and you often partner across some kind of distance or difference.

capricorn.definition: You are drawn to substance. Partnership brings you people who are serious and capable, and through them you learn to commit properly.
capricorn.showsUp: You are attracted to maturity and self-command, you take a long view of relationships, and you may partner with someone older or more established.

aquarius.definition: You are drawn to independence. Partnership brings you people who are their own, and through them you learn to hold your own separateness.
aquarius.showsUp: You need friendship at the centre of a relationship, you resist convention about how it should look, and you are attracted to originality.

pisces.definition: You are drawn to sensitivity. Partnership brings you people who feel a great deal, and through them you learn compassion and where your edges are.
pisces.showsUp: You are attracted to gentleness and imagination, you can idealise a partner, and you have to learn to see the person rather than the potential.
